'''Gendar's father''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was sentenced to survive in the [[Undercity (Taris)|Undercity]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] like [[Gendar's grandfather|his father]] before him. He led the [[Outcast village|village]] like his father did. He eventually had a son named [[Gendar]], who succeeded him as leader.
